'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come here, I've got a test for you. You must always maintain your composure, in every situation. You lose control or panic - you die. And no matter what happened - whether you've caught a bullet or just got drunk. But even with shaky hands, you have to shoot sharp. Prove to me that you can do this.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 2 PMC operatives with headshots while suffering from the tremor effect

==Rewards==
* +5,900 [[EXP]]
* +1 [[Stress Resistance|Stress Resistance skill]] level
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 75,000 Roubles
** 78,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 86,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|So you can even handle tremors? Great! To be honest, I didn't think you would succeed, the task was very difficult.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 2 PMC's with headshots while suffering from [[File:Tremor.png|46px|Hands tremor|link=]]. Hands tremor is caused by 45 seconds of untreated pain. You can also use a [[SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector]] to get the effect on demand.
